# Skill catalog

<!-- generated by `python -m omi skills`; do not edit -->
- omi-skill-write-skill (authoring): Use when creating or revising an omi-skill; gives the contract, trigger wording and acceptance test. [~755 tokens]
- omi-skill-data-review (data): Use when reviewing or writing SQL, migrations, indexes, schema or row-level permissions for a PostgreSQL database, or when queries are slow or rows leak across users. [~1063 tokens]
- omi-skill-docker-worker-pitfalls (delivery-ops): Use when an omi worker or run container fails, cannot write, cannot run git or the CLI, leaves containers or images behind, or when changing the worker Dockerfile. [~707 tokens]
- omi-skill-incident (delivery-ops): Use when something broke in a release, CI gate, ruleset, tag or worker run and you must triage, contain and record it. [~540 tokens]
- omi-skill-release-checklist (delivery-ops): Use when preparing, promoting or tagging a release (rc tag, development -> staging -> main PRs, v* tag) or checking a release PR before the PO tests it. [~659 tokens]
- omi-skill-rollback (delivery-ops): Use when a released candidate or main is bad and must be undone, by reverting the promotion merge or redeploying the previous rc tag. [~545 tokens]
- omi-skill-windows-powershell (delivery-ops): Use when running omi, git, gh, docker or shell scripts on Windows PowerShell or Git Bash, or when a command works on Linux but fails on the PO's Windows machine. [~554 tokens]
- omi-skill-web-qa (qa-web): Use when a web change needs a browser regression check with screenshot evidence, or a UI bug must be reproduced in a real browser. [~766 tokens]
- omi-skill-ci-workflow-audit (quality): Use when adding or reviewing GitHub Actions workflows, especially those that run AI agents or act on pull requests from forks or issues. [~657 tokens]
- omi-skill-debug-root-cause (quality): Use when a test fails or behaviour is wrong, before fixing. [~294 tokens]
- omi-skill-diff-security-review (quality): Use when reviewing a code change for security regressions, especially auth, input handling, secrets, crypto or dependency changes. [~641 tokens]
- omi-skill-simplify-review (quality): Use when reviewing a diff for over-engineering, needless dependencies or speculative abstractions; lists what to cut. [~549 tokens]
- omi-skill-verify-evidence (quality): Use when about to say work is done, fixed or passing, before reporting DONE, committing or approving a review. [~539 tokens]
- omi-skill-ui-a11y-review (ui): Use when reviewing or building web UI for accessibility: labels, contrast, keyboard, focus, semantics, motion. [~689 tokens]
- omi-skill-ui-direction (ui): Use when building or restyling a web UI and it must not look generic: fonts, spacing, color, shadows, states, complete output. [~1107 tokens]
- omi-skill-brainstorm-ac (workflow): Use when a requirement or feature request is vague and must become testable acceptance criteria before a task file is written. [~621 tokens]
- omi-skill-change-request (workflow): Use when requirements, scope or an approved decision change after a task started, or an engineer reports NEEDS SCOPE. [~528 tokens]
- omi-skill-lean-implementation (workflow): Use when writing or fixing code and tempted to add abstractions, dependencies or config; keeps the diff minimal (YAGNI, stdlib first). [~576 tokens]
- omi-skill-task-brief (workflow): Use when a task file must be complete enough for a fresh engineer agent with zero context, before `omi run`. [~658 tokens]
